# ConsciousOS

> The Operating System for Consciousness — an AI-guided consciousness instrument with mental-loop detection, witness practice, journaling, and a 500-day journey inward.

ConsciousOS is a consciousness-tech platform that blends ancient yogic frameworks (Patanjali's 8 limbs, Advaita self-inquiry, Vipassana witness practice, the 11-band spiral) with modern AI. It detects mental loops in real time, runs guided sessions with 118 master personalities (Krishna, Buddha, Ramana, Rumi, Patanjali, Lao Tzu, etc.), tracks an 11-band V-Level consciousness map across 6 dimensions, and adapts a daily 4-gate practice flow to each user's spiritual DNA.

Built by an independent founder. Hosted on Lovable Cloud. Pricing is credit-based via Razorpay — no streaks, no leaderboards, no guilt loops.
